category: Figure Matrix (Class A vs Class B Enclosure Logic)
question_text: Class A contains figures where a CIRCLE is nested INSIDE a polygon. Class B contains figures where a POLYGON is nested INSIDE a circle. Which option belongs to Class A?

reference_figures.label: Class A Example
reference_figures.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='50,15 85,85 15,85' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='50' cy='60' r='15' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/></svg>

reference_figures.label: Class B Example
reference_figures.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='40' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/><rect x='30' y='30' width='40' height='40' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/></svg>

options.label: A
options.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='40' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/><polygon points='50,20 75,70 25,70' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/></svg>

options.label: B
options.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><rect x='20' y='20' width='60' height='60' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='25' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/></svg>

options.label: C
options.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><rect x='20' y='20' width='60' height='60' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/><rect x='35' y='35' width='30' height='30' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/></svg>

explanation: Class A specifically requires the outermost shape to be a polygon (straight edges) and the innermost shape to be a circle. Option B features a square as the outer boundary with a circle nested inside.

question_text: Find if the two cubes are alike. Write 'Yes' or 'No'.

reference_figures.label: Cube 1
reference_figures.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><path d='M30 30 L70 30 L85 15 L45 15 Z M30 30 L30 70 L70 70 L70 30 M70 70 L85 55 L85 15' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><polygon points='50,40 60,60 40,60' fill='black'/><circle cx='52' cy='26' r='5' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><polyline points='72,40 82,40 77,50' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/></svg>

reference_figures.label: Cube 2
reference_figures.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><path d='M30 30 L70 30 L85 15 L45 15 Z M30 30 L30 70 L70 70 L70 30 M70 70 L85 55 L85 15' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='5' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><polyline points='47,21 57,21 52,31' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><polygon points='76,40 82,55 70,55' fill='black'/></svg>

explanation: In Cube 1, reading clockwise around the shared vertex gives: Solid Triangle -> Hollow Circle -> V-Shape. If you roll Cube 1 forward, the Hollow Circle comes to the front, the V-Shape moves to the top, and the Solid Triangle swings to the right face. This matches Cube 2 perfectly.
